<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 6"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Stonebound Magic](/Feats.aspx?ID=4381) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=12" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #195: Heavy is the Crown](/Sources.aspx?ID=210) pg. 83

**Archetype** [Stonebound](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=210)

**Prerequisites**
[Stonebound Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=4377)

</column>

---

You've learned to manifest your connection to stone by conjuring it to your side. You gain [_scatter scree_](/Spells.aspx?ID=990) as a primal innate cantrip. At 8th level, you gain [_meld into stone_](/Spells.aspx?ID=188) as a primal innate spell once per day. At 10th level, you gain [_shape stone_](/Spells.aspx?ID=276) as a primal innate spell once per day. At 12th level, you gain [_wall of stone_](/Spells.aspx?ID=365) as a primal innate spell once per day.
